Brazilians have sent incumbent President Lula and Jair Bolsonaro's son Flavio to a runoff after Brazil held the first round of its presidential election on Sunday.

📰 Too Long: https://toolong.news/
🎉 TLDR Party:  https://toolong.news/pages/tldr-party
📖 Read our Manifesto: https://tldrnews.co.uk/manifesto

Our mission is to explain news and politics in an impartial, efficient, and accessible way, balancing import and interest while fostering independent thought.

TLDR is a completely independent & privately owned media company that's not afraid to tackle the issues we think are most important. The channel is run by a small group of young people, with us hoping to pass on our enthusiasm for politics to other young people. We are primarily fan sourced with most of our funding coming from donations and ad revenue. No shady corporations, no one telling us what to say. We can't wait to grow further and help more people get informed. Help support us by subscribing, engaging and sharing. Thanks!

SOURCES:
Election results:
 https://resultados.tse.jus.br/oficial/app/index.html#/eleicao/6257/uf/br/cargo/1/vis/nominal/resultados 

Flavio linked to Banco Master scandal:
https://apnews.com/article/brazil-flavio-bolsonaro-investigation-banco-master-movie-f534de4498df7d8b509127fcee2b535d 

Flavio’s feud with Catholic Church over patron saint:
https://cruxnow.com/church-in-the-americas/2026/10/what-to-know-about-the-viral-claim-about-brazils-patron-saint-jolting-a-tight-presidential-race 

Banco Master scandal, Lula and Moraes:
https://www.bloomberg.com/graphics/2026-banco-master-brazil-supreme-court-presidential-election/ 

Lula defends economic record:
https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/income-tax-break-adds-lulas-economic-tailwinds-ahead-brazil-election-2026-02-11/ 
https://valorinternational.globo.com/economy/news/2026/09/29/brazil-unemployment-rate-falls-to-record-low-53percent.ghtml 

Cost of living concerns/household debt:
https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/brazil-frustration-over-cost-living-undermines-lulas-reelection-bid-2026-09-26/ 
https://www.nytimes.com/2026/10/01/world/americas/brazil-gambling-debts-elections.html 

Brazil’s homicide rate is down, but security still major concern for voters:
 https://www.economist.com/the-americas/2026/09/17/brazils-gangsters-less-murder-more-money
https://www.americasquarterly.org/article/despite-record-low-murder-rates-brazilians-feel-less-safe/ 

Lula boosts Bolsa Familia and bans online betting:
 https://apnews.com/article/brazil-election-lula-welfare-b0e6975c4110dab4e4181760150fdb2c 
https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/sep/26/lula-bans-fixed-odds-sports-betting-a-week-before-brazilian-elections 

Brian Winter, ‘apathetic polarisation’:
 https://x.com/BrazilBrian/status/2102025256055472488 

Lula and Flavio equal rejection rates:
https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/internacional/en/brazil/2026/10/datafolha-poll-lula-has-45-and-flavio-bolsonaro-40-of-valid-votes-in-first-round.shtml 

How winner will impact Supreme Court:
https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/how-brazils-election-winner-could-reshape-its-institutions-vacancies-mount-2026-10-02/ 

Democratic trajectory at stake:
 https://www.brookings.edu/articles/what-kind-of-brazil-will-emerge-from-this-election/ 

Flavio on climate change, Amazon deforestation:
 https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c6wyz0r2n0djo 
 https://apnews.com/article/brazil-elections-amazon-lula-flavio-bolsonaro-eacb0832cd11cf40b0b2a24481439d1f 
 
Flavio’s security policies:
https://english.elpais.com/international/2026-06-19/flavio-bolsonaro-proposes-five-bukelestyle-prisons-lowering-the-age-of-criminal-responsibility-and-chemical-castration-in-brazil.html 

Lula’s multi-alignment:
 https://www.brookings.edu/articles/what-kind-of-brazil-will-emerge-from-this-election/ 

How Flavio would reorient Brazil’s foreign policy:
https://valorinternational.globo.com/politics/news/2026/09/22/sovereignty-takes-center-stage-in-foreign-policy-electoral-platforms.ghtml 
https://www.cfr.org/articles/brazils-2026-election-what-to-know-and-whats-at-stake 

US interference claims:
https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-09-22/brazil-election-lula-warns-against-meddling-at-un-as-trump-looms-over-vote 
 https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/us-revoke-visas-brazilian-solicitor-general-other-officials-2025-09-22/ 
 https://time.com/article/2026/10/01/trump-brazil-election-interference-accusations-lula-bolsonaro-tensions/
